limits.rule: The Packet is what you know, not the fence around what you may write. The approved facts and the ledger are canon: never contradict them, and never import real-world Oakland (its people, businesses, landmarks, troubles). Everything else — the scene, the street, the weather in the room, unnamed people and what they say, new in-world places and businesses, what the city is talking about — is yours to invent; that colour is the job, and it never rewrites a canon fact. A named ledger citizen speaks only in their approved quote or their own page line. No named ledger citizen spoke for this piece (manifest.approvedQuotes is empty): put no words in a named citizen's mouth. Unnamed voices are yours. Do not brief the record. Open on a person or place living the condition.

reviewProfile.purpose: Put one Packet-backed present fact in the river of the Richmond Archive: where the man came from, the road to Oakland, the name the city gave him, his own recorded words, what he became. The Origins of the Dynasty series is the bar for who Hal is. The archive is read through the tools, never recalled; what it holds is his to cite. Invented current stats and real-world Oakland geography still fail.
